title: eriolobus delavayi
intro: Eriolobus delavayi, commonly known as the Chinese spurge, is a plant species in the family Anacardiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its potential to improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Eriolobus delavayi are attributed to its ability to inhibit pro-inflammatory enzymes and its antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various conditions such as arthritis and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Eriolobus delavayi include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
